test a different weighting method (softmax_neg_error) to see if high‑variance weight estimation improves over inverse_error.
The series is trend-dominated with moderate ranking stability; a simple mean over the full pool may capture complementary errors and is a different kind of strategy (unweighted).
The series is trend-dominated and ranking tau is moderate; a per‑horizon selective weight may capture any horizon‑specific strengths.
The series has high trend and moderate ranking stability; a trimmed mean may reduce influence of outlier models.
try a non‑weighted selective combination – median over the full pool (median has low sensitivity to outliers, fits the “selective” hint).
The leader is a weighted selective pool; a different kind of strategy is needed – try a DBA combination over the full pool to explore a new algorithmic family.
The series is trend-dominated with moderate ranking stability; a simple mean over the selective pool4 may outperform weighted versions.
The series is trend‑dominated with moderate ranking stability; a DBA (diverse‐balance‑aggregation) could better exploit complementary models in the selective pool.

decision.justification: Selected 'median on pool4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.5616. Series context: trend strength 0.9651 and seasonal strength 0.0; model ranking is moderate across windows (Kendall tau 0.657); 3 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 3.072.
